purpose: Chinese-primary revision of the physics and chemistry candidates after supervisor review.
physicsConditionRules: all acceleration, final-velocity and displacement prompts must explicitly state constant acceleration or uniformly accelerated straight-line motion
a prompt asking for average acceleration must explicitly use the term average acceleration
scenario magnitudes must be credible for the named entity
chemistryConditionRules: all candidates require numerical pH calculation
operational purposes must be credible and naturally integrated
no templated purpose suffix may be appended after the question
hardAcceptanceRules: blind reviewer derives exactly one correct option
conditions are sufficient and no material ambiguity is found
deterministic Solver and independent Oracle agree
explanation verifier and QuestionPlan adherence pass
no localizations or unverified English auxiliary rendering is present
unknown, abstain, missing evidence or disagreement always quarantines
